## Professional summary

Vitaly Chait is a software engineer and applied AI researcher with ten years of engineering experience across software, semiconductor systems, quantitative analytics, and technical education. His professional and academic work spans the United States, Israel, and China.

## Current work

Graduate Research and Teaching Assistant at Brandeis University, August 2026 to present.

Primary themes:
- Artificial intelligence research and applied evaluation
- PyTorch experimentation and model development
- Teaching, mentoring, and technical leadership

## Education

- Master of Science in Business Analytics candidate, Brandeis International Business School
- Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, The Open University of Israel
- Artificial intelligence coursework at MIT. This is coursework, not an MIT degree

## Selected professional experience

- NeuroBlade, Software Engineer in Tel Aviv, Israel, January 2023 to September 2025. Integrated accelerator with Spark and Presto on 3 TB+ workloads using TPC-H and TPC-DS, helping improve performance from 0.8x to 4x the CPU baseline. C diagnostics across PCIe, NVMe, switches, and FPGAs, including JTAG. Hardware bring-up, power telemetry, firmware upgrades, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability, and customer-site deployment
- Orbotech, acquired by KLA, System Engineer in Israel from August 2018 to July 2021 and Resident Engineer in Beijing from August 2017 to July 2018
- Independent software engineering work in Beijing from July 2021 to January 2023, including Flask services and TFLite with OpenCV
- Quantitative asset pipeline work connected with State Street Global Advisors

## Selected projects and research

- PolyGains, co-developer. Backend data streaming, real-time transaction ingestion, order flow, wallet clustering, and prediction-market analytics. Brandeis Ain Family Start-Up Award
- Brandeis research under Professor Shubhranshu Shekhar. Dynamic profanity benchmark accounting for sociolinguistic context and adolescent vernacular, with a paper being prepared for a possible NeurIPS submission. Broader multi-turn safety evaluation
- Multi-asset meta-labeling portfolio pipeline for State Street Global Advisors with Xuesong Hu in summer 2026
- Sundai Club participant and volunteer from 2025 to 2026, including a weekend hackathon and the Sundai Anniversary event at Boston University
- Sundai projects: WearableDisplays, Social Media Police, and Flight or Fight
